Measured just now:
- `npm view @objectstack/spec dist-tags`: `next` is `18.0.0-next.2`, published 2026-10-16T03:11Z.
- The objectstack half, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24010 (`66d2757024`), was committed 2026-10-16T20:09Z, after that prerelease. So no installable `@objectstack/spec` exports `InstalledPackageSourceSchema`, and no released runtime serves `row.source`.

The card's Done-when forbids a fallback to the join when `source` is absent ("Declare equals enforce"). Against today's installable backend, every row would then be refused, so dispatching now would break the page for anyone on `18.0.0-next.2`. The triage note's "read it untyped" helps the typing, not the missing key.

Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` names a prerelease newer than `18.0.0-next.2`, and that tarball's `kernel` entry exports `InstalledPackageSourceSchema`

Dispatch shape on wake (pre-written): one os-dev on `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/packageSource.ts` and `PackagesPage.tsx`, after the `@objectstack/spec` bump carrying the schema is on objectui `main`. Read `row.source`; retire `readMarketplaceInstalls` on this page and `PACKAGE_SOURCE_CONFLICT`; refuse an absent or unknown `source` by name; use the spec's row type. Pins as the card lists them. objectui#12723, the same page, is closed, so there is no overlap.
